title: 4-Axis Evaluation Matrix
description: Select an evaluation axis to explore its configurations, supported targets, and methodology.

axes.heading: Axis 1: Tooling Configurations
axes.overview: FlutterBench tests three configurations to isolate the impact of specialized Dart and Flutter AI tools (skills, MCP tools, compiler diagnostics, and sandboxes).

items.label: Baseline
items.detail: No specialized Dart or Flutter tools loaded — tests raw model capability and baseline reasoning.

items.label: Enhanced
items.detail: Full suite of Dart and Flutter skills, MCP server tools, and compiler diagnostics loaded.

items.label: Enhanced Minus N
items.detail: Full suite with a specific tool or skill group ablated to measure its isolated delta.

axes.footer_text: This A/B testing approach isolates whether adding specific tools (such as widget inspection or analyzer fixes) measurably improves task success rates.

axes.heading: Axis 2: Frontier Model Families
axes.overview: Evaluations span major frontier model families across high-capability reasoning tiers and low-latency production tiers.

items.label: Gemini
items.detail: Evaluated across Gemini Pro (deep reasoning and complex architecture) and Gemini Flash (low-latency generation) tiers.

items.label: Claude
items.detail: Evaluated across Claude Opus (heavy multi-file refactoring) and Claude Sonnet (daily developer workflows).

items.label: ChatGPT
items.detail: Evaluated across the GPT-4o series and specialized reasoning checkpoints.

axes.footer_text: Additional providers and local open-weights models are integrated continuously based on community feedback and developer adoption.

axes.heading: Axis 3: Agent Runtime Harnesses
axes.overview: Different agents employ distinct system prompts, context management techniques, and tool-loading strategies. We evaluate the CLI agents Flutter developers use most.

items.label: Antigravity CLI
items.detail: Google's developer agent harness featuring optimized tool discovery, compact context budgets, and deep IDE integration.

items.label: Claude Code
items.detail: Anthropic's terminal-based agent harness with autonomous multi-turn problem-solving capabilities.

axes.footer_text: Testing across multiple harnesses isolates model intelligence from agent runtime orchestration, measuring how execution environments influence success.

axes.heading: Axis 4: SDK Release Channels
axes.overview: Evaluations run against both Flutter release channels to verify developer-ready reliability and detect framework regressions early.

items.label: Stable
items.detail: The current production SDK release — measures developer-ready reliability on the version used by most teams.

items.label: Beta
items.detail: Monthly beta releases — catches deprecation migrations, API evolutions, and analyzer changes before stable rollout.

axes.footer_text: Ensures AI tooling and skills maintain precision as the Flutter framework and Dart language evolve.
